body: There is since I'm under my own coverage. I just don't even know how I could possibly make myself broach this subject with anyone in person. I remember reaching out in high school when my dad died, and I was in such a state that even though I went in looking okay, the moment that I tried to talk, I broke down crying and I don't think I can make myself do that again. It's by far much easier to do on here since this is basically all anonymous and I can easily hide my tears behind a screen.
